title: Land bee-verifying and bee-verify-upkeep in the bee-* namespace
verify: bee dev regen && bee dev release-manifest --check
action: Move the two proven verification skills into bee's own namespace so onboard can install them into host repos (per D1). Source them from .claude/skills/create-verification-skill/ and .claude/skills/maintain-verification-skill/, which are byte-identical copies of pstack v0.14.5. Create skills/bee-verifying/ from the generator (carry its references/feature-map-example/ tree across unchanged) and skills/bee-verify-upkeep/ from the maintainer. KEEP the disable-model-invocation: true key in both frontmatters - the hat wave found it is honored by Claude Code and keeps both out of the always-loaded routing surface, so the context cost of D1 is near zero. Rewrite each description to name its own trigger: bee-verifying fires once, when a repo has no scripted way to prove product behavior; bee-verify-upkeep fires periodically, to audit an existing verification skill's feature map. Replace every .cursor/skills/ path with the bee equivalent, and every reference to the other skill's old name. Do NOT touch any Rust file and do NOT add a proof tier or a door (per D4) - this cell is skills plus regen only. Finish by running the regen chain in order (render-skill-trees, onboard --repo-root . --apply, release-manifest --write) so the committed per-runtime trees carry both new skills.
